title: Unit 14 Consolidation: Nuclear Energy, the Paks Dilemma & Renewables in the Carpathian Basin
goal: I can recount the history of Paks I and the debate about extending its lifetime.
I can describe the Paks II agreement, the Bős–Nagymaros dispute and the ruling of 1997.
I can explain what geothermal energy and solar power can add to Hungarian energy supply.
